units.zh: 劉敬者，齊人也。
units.en: Liu Jing was a native of Qi.
units.literal: Liu Jing was a man of Qi.

units.zh: 漢五年，戍隴西，過洛陽，高帝在焉。
units.en: In the fifth year of the Han dynasty, while on garrison duty in Longxi, he passed through Luoyang, where Emperor Gao was residing.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Han, he was garrisoned in Longxi and passed through Luoyang where the Gao Emperor was.

units.zh: 婁敬脫輓輅，衣其羊裘，見齊人虞將軍曰：「臣願見上言便事。」
units.en: Lou Jing stepped down from his cart, put on his sheepskin coat, and went to see Yu the General, a fellow man of Qi. He said, 'I wish to see the Sovereign and present a matter of advantage.'
units.literal: Lou Jing stepped down from the draught cart, put on his sheepskin coat, went to see Yu the General, a man of Qi, and said, 'I wish to see the Sovereign and speak on a matter of advantage.'

units.zh: 虞將軍欲與之鮮衣，婁敬曰：「臣衣帛，衣帛見；
units.en: General Yu wished to give him fine clothes. Lou Jing said, 'If I wear silk, I shall go to audience in silk;
units.literal: General Yu wished to give him fine clothes. Lou Jing said, 'If I wear silk, I shall appear in silk;

units.zh: 衣褐，衣褐見：終不敢易衣。」
units.en: if I wear coarse cloth, I shall go to audience in coarse cloth—I ultimately dare not change my clothes.'
units.literal: if I wear coarse cloth, I shall appear in coarse cloth. I ultimately dare not change clothes.'

units.zh: 於是虞將軍入言上。
units.en: General Yu then went in and reported this to the Emperor.
units.literal: Thereupon General Yu entered and spoke to the Sovereign.

units.zh: 上召入見，賜食。
units.en: The Emperor summoned him for an audience and bestowed a meal upon him.
units.literal: The Sovereign summoned him to enter and see him, granting him food.

units.zh: 已而問婁敬，婁敬說曰：「陛下都洛陽，豈欲與周室比隆哉？」
units.en: Then he questioned Lou Jing. Lou Jing said, 'Your Majesty is establishing the capital at Luoyang—do you wish to rival the Zhou in splendor?'
units.literal: Then he asked Lou Jing. Lou Jing said, 'Your Majesty is making Luoyang the capital—do you wish to rival the Zhou in glory?'

units.zh: 上曰：「然。」
units.en: The Emperor said, 'Yes.'
units.literal: The Emperor said, 'Yes.'

units.zh: 婁敬曰：「陛下取天下與周室異。
units.en: Lou Jing said: "Your Majesty took the empire differently from the Zhou house.
units.literal: Lou Jing said: 'Your Majesty took all-under-heaven differently from the Zhou house.

units.zh: 周之先自后稷，堯封之邰，積德累善十有餘世。
units.en: The Zhou ancestors began with Hou Ji, whom Yao enfeoffed at Tai, accumulating virtue and goodness for more than ten generations.
units.literal: Zhou's ancestors from Hou Ji, Yao enfeoffed him Tai, accumulated virtue piled goodness ten plus generations.

units.zh: 公劉避桀居豳。
units.en: Duke Liu fled from Jie and settled at Bin.
units.literal: Duke Liu fled from Jie and dwelt at Bin.

units.zh: 太王以狄伐故，去豳，杖馬箠居岐，國人爭隨之。
units.en: Because of Di attacks, King Tai left Bin. Leaning on his riding crop, he settled at Qiyi, and the people of his state vied to follow him.
units.literal: Because of Di attacks, King Tai left Bin, leaned on his horse whip and dwelt at Qiyi, and the people of the state contended to follow him.

units.zh: 及文王為西伯，斷虞芮之訟，始受命，呂望、伯夷自海濱來歸之。
units.en: When Wen Wang became Western Bo, he adjudicated the dispute between Yu and Rui, began receiving the mandate, and Lü Wang and Bo Yi came from the seacoast to submit to him.
units.literal: When Wen Wang became Western Bo, adjudicated Yu Rui's dispute, began received mandate, Lü Wang, Bo Yi from seacoast came submitted to him.

units.zh: 武王伐紂，不期而會孟津之上八百諸侯，皆曰紂可伐矣，遂滅殷。
units.en: When King Wu marched against Zhou, eight hundred lords gathered unbidden at Mengjin. All said, 'Zhou can be attacked,' and he then destroyed the Yin dynasty.
units.literal: King Wu attacked Zhou. Without prior arrangement, eight hundred feudal lords met him above Mengjin; all said, 'Zhou can be attacked,' and he then extinguished Yin.

units.zh: 成王即位，周公之屬傅相焉，乃營成周洛邑，以此為天下之中也，諸侯四方納貢職，道裏均矣，有德則易以王，無德則易以亡。
units.en: When King Cheng ascended the throne, Zhou Gong's kinsmen served as his tutors and ministers. They then built Chengzhou at Luoyi, making it the center of the realm, so that the feudal lords from the four directions could submit tribute and service over balanced routes. With virtue, one could easily become king; without virtue, one could easily perish.
units.literal: Cheng Wang ascended the throne, and Zhou Gong's kinsmen served as tutors and ministers to him. They then built Chengzhou at Luoyi, making it the center of the realm, so that the feudal lords from the four directions submitted tribute and duties at equal road distances. With virtue one could easily become king; without virtue one could easily perish.

units.zh: 凡居此者，欲令周務以德致人，不欲依阻險，令後世驕奢以虐民也。
units.en: All who chose to reside there wished the Zhou to devote themselves to attracting the people through virtue, not to rely on natural defenses, lest future generations grow arrogant and extravagant and oppress the people.
units.literal: All who dwelt here desired to make Zhou attend to attracting people with virtue, not desiring to rely on strategic defiles, so as to prevent later generations from becoming arrogant and extravagant in oppressing the people.

units.zh: 及周之盛時，天下和洽，四夷鄉風，慕義懷德，附離而并事天子，不屯一卒，不戰一士，八夷大國之民莫不賓服，效其貢職。
units.en: When Zhou was flourishing, the realm was harmonious and at peace. The four Yi turned toward its customs, admired righteousness, cherished virtue, attached themselves to it though far away, and together served the Son of Heaven. Without stationing a single soldier or fighting a single warrior, the people of the eight Yi and the great states all submitted and presented their tribute and service.
units.literal: When Zhou was flourishing, the realm was harmonious and at peace. The four Yi turned toward its customs, admired righteousness, cherished virtue, attached themselves to it though far away, and together served the Son of Heaven. Without stationing a single soldier or fighting a single warrior, the people of the eight Yi and the great states all submitted and presented their tribute and duties.

units.zh: 及周之衰也，分而為兩，天下莫朝，周不能制也。
units.en: When Zhou declined, it split in two. None in the realm came to court, and Zhou could no longer control them.
units.literal: When Zhou declined, it divided into two, none in the realm came to court, and Zhou could no longer control them.

units.zh: 非其德薄也，而形勢弱也。
units.en: It was not that their virtue was lacking, but that their strategic position was weak.
units.literal: It was not that their virtue was thin, but that their strategic position was weak.

units.zh: 今陛下起豐沛，收卒三千人，以之徑往而卷蜀漢，定三秦，與項羽戰滎陽，爭成皋之口，大戰七十，小戰四十，使天下之民肝腦涂地，父子暴骨中野，不可勝數，哭泣之聲未絕，傷痍者未起，而欲比隆於成康之時，臣竊以為不侔也。
units.en: Now Your Majesty arose from Feng and Pei, gathered three thousand soldiers, and with them swept through Shu and Han, pacified the Three Qins, battled Xiang Yu at Xingyang, and fought for the pass at Chenggao. In seventy great battles and forty small battles, the people of the realm had their livers and brains smeared on the ground, and fathers and sons exposed their bones in the fields beyond counting. The sound of weeping has not ceased, the wounded have not yet risen, and yet you wish to compare your flourishing age with the time of Cheng and Kang. I privately think they are not equal.
units.literal: Now Your Majesty arose from Feng and Pei, gathered three thousand soldiers, and with them went straight on to sweep through Shu and Han, pacify the Three Qins, battle Xiang Yu at Xingyang, and contend for the pass at Chenggao. In seventy great battles and forty small battles, the people of the realm had their livers and brains smeared on the ground, and fathers and sons exposed their bones in the fields beyond counting. The sounds of weeping have not ceased, the wounded have not yet risen, yet you wish to compare your flourishing age with the time of Cheng and Kang. I privately think they are not equal.

units.zh: 且夫秦地被山帶河，四塞以為固，卒然有急，百萬之眾可具也。
units.en: Moreover, the land of Qin is flanked by mountains and belted by the Yellow River, secured on all four sides by strategic passes. Should an emergency suddenly arise, an army of a million could be assembled.
units.literal: Moreover, Qin territory is covered by mountains and girded by rivers, with four strategic passes making it firm. If suddenly there is an emergency, a million multitudes can be prepared.

units.zh: 因秦之故，資甚美膏腴之地，此所謂天府者也。
units.en: Building on the foundations of Qin, it commands lands of exceptional fertility—this is what men call the Heavenly Storehouse.
units.literal: Following Qin's example, it has resources of very beautiful fertile lands—this is what is called the heavenly storehouse.

units.zh: 陛下入關而都之，山東雖亂，秦之故地可全而有也。
units.en: If Your Majesty enters the passes and establishes the capital there, then even should the lands east of the mountains fall into chaos, the old territories of Qin can be held in their entirety.
units.literal: If Your Majesty enters the pass and makes it the capital, even if Shandong is chaotic, Qin's old lands can be completely preserved.

units.zh: 夫與人鬬，不搤其亢，拊其背，未能全其勝也。
units.en: When wrestling an opponent, if you do not seize him by the throat but merely pat his back, you cannot secure a complete victory.
units.literal: Now when fighting with a person, if you do not grasp his throat but pat his back, you cannot complete your victory.

units.zh: 今陛下入關而都，案秦之故地，此亦搤天下之亢而拊其背也。」
units.en: Now if Your Majesty enters the passes and establishes the capital there, holding Qin's old territories, this too seizes the realm by the throat while pressing on its back."
units.literal: Now if Your Majesty enters the passes and establishes the capital there, holding Qin's old lands, this too is seizing the realm by the throat while pressing on its back.'

units.zh: 高帝問群臣，群臣皆山東人，爭言周王數百年，秦二世即亡，不如都周。
units.en: Emperor Gao consulted his ministers, but they were all men from east of the mountains. They argued that the Zhou had reigned for several hundred years while the Qin fell after just two generations, making it far better to establish the capital at the old Zhou site.
units.literal: Emperor Gao asked the assembled ministers. The ministers, all being men from east of the mountains, contended that the Zhou had ruled for several hundred years while the Qin perished after two generations—it would be better to establish the capital at Zhou.

units.zh: 上疑未能決。
units.en: The Emperor was uncertain and could not reach a decision.
units.literal: The Sovereign doubted and could not decide.

units.zh: 及留侯明言入關便，即日車駕西都關中。
units.en: When the Marquis of Liu clearly stated the advantages of entering the passes, that very day the imperial carriage set out westward to establish the capital in Guanzhong.
units.literal: When Liu Hou clearly spoke of the convenience of entering the pass, that very day the carriage drove west to make Guanzhong the capital.

units.zh: 於是上曰：「本言都秦地者婁敬，『婁』者乃『劉』也。」
units.en: The Emperor then said, "The one who originally spoke of establishing the capital in Qin territory was Lou Jing; Lou is Liu."
units.literal: The Emperor then said, 'The one who originally spoke of establishing the capital in Qin territory was Lou Jing—"Lou" is "Liu."'

units.zh: 賜姓劉氏，拜為郎中，號為奉春君。
units.en: He was granted the imperial surname Liu, appointed as a Palace Attendant, and given the title Lord of Fengchun.
units.literal: He was granted the surname Liu, appointed as Palace Attendant, and titled Lord Fengchun.

units.zh: 漢七年，韓王信反，高帝自往擊之。
units.en: In the seventh year of the Han dynasty, King Xin of Han rebelled, and Emperor Gao personally led a campaign against him.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Han, King Xin of Han rebelled, and the Gao Emperor personally went to strike him.

units.zh: 至晉陽，聞信與匈奴欲共擊漢，上大怒，使人使匈奴。
units.en: Upon reaching Jinyang, he learned that Xin intended to join forces with the Xiongnu to attack Han. The Emperor was furious and sent envoys to the Xiongnu.
units.literal: He arrived at Jinyang and heard that Xin, together with the Xiongnu, intended to attack Han together. The Emperor was greatly angered and sent envoys to the Xiongnu.

units.zh: 匈奴匿其壯士肥牛馬，但見老弱及羸畜。
units.en: The Xiongnu hid their finest warriors and fattest cattle and horses, displaying only the old and weak along with emaciated livestock.
units.literal: The Xiongnu hid their strong warriors and fat oxen and horses, only showing old and weak people and emaciated livestock.

units.zh: 使者十輩來，皆言匈奴可擊。
units.en: Envoys returned in ten successive groups, all reporting that the Xiongnu could be attacked.
units.literal: Envoys came in ten groups, all saying the Xiongnu could be struck.

units.zh: 上使劉敬復往使匈奴，還報曰：「兩國相擊，此宜夸矜見所長。
units.en: The Emperor again sent Liu Jing as envoy to the Xiongnu. Jing returned and reported, "When two states are about to fight, each ought to boast and show off its strengths.
units.literal: The Emperor sent Liu Jing again as envoy to the Xiongnu. He returned and reported, 'When two states are about to fight, each should boast and display its strengths.

units.zh: 今臣往，徒見羸瘠老弱，此必欲見短，伏奇兵以爭利。
units.en: When I went, all I saw were the emaciated, the old, and the weak. They are surely displaying their weaknesses while concealing crack troops to seize the advantage.
units.literal: Now when I went, I only saw emaciated, old, and weak people. This certainly means they desire to show weaknesses while hiding crack troops to contend for advantage.

units.zh: 愚以為匈奴不可擊也。」
units.en: In my humble opinion, the Xiongnu must not be attacked."
units.literal: In my foolish opinion, the Xiongnu cannot be attacked.'

units.zh: 是時漢兵已踰句注，二十餘萬兵已業行。
units.en: By this time, the Han forces had already crossed the Gouzhu Pass, and over two hundred thousand troops were already on the march.
units.literal: At this time Han troops had already crossed Gouzhu, and more than two hundred thousand soldiers were already on the march.

units.zh: 上怒，罵劉敬曰：「齊虜！
units.en: The Sovereign was angered and cursed Liu Jing, saying: 'Qi captive!
units.literal: Sovereign angered, cursed Liu Jing said: 'Qi captive!

units.zh: 以口舌得官，今乃妄言沮吾軍。」
units.en: You gained office with your tongue, and now you make reckless claims to obstruct my army."
units.literal: You got your office with your tongue—now you speak reckless words to obstruct my army.'

units.zh: 械系敬廣武。
units.en: He had Liu Jing shackled and imprisoned at Guangwu.
units.literal: He shackled and bound Jing at Guangwu.

units.zh: 遂往，至平城，匈奴果出奇兵圍高帝白登，七日然後得解。
units.en: He pressed onward to Pingcheng, where the Xiongnu indeed unleashed their hidden forces and surrounded Emperor Gao at Baideng. Only after seven days was the siege lifted.
units.literal: He then went, arrived at Pingcheng, and the Xiongnu indeed sent crack troops that surrounded the Gao Emperor at Baideng. Only after seven days did he get release.

units.zh: 高帝至廣武，赦敬，曰：「吾不用公言，以困平城。
units.en: When Emperor Gao reached Guangwu, he pardoned Jing and said, "Because I did not use your advice, I was trapped at Pingcheng.
units.literal: Emperor Gao arrived at Guangwu, pardoned Jing, and said, 'I did not heed your words and was trapped at Pingcheng.

units.zh: 吾皆已斬前使十輩言可擊者矣。」
units.en: I have already beheaded all ten earlier groups of envoys who said the Xiongnu could be attacked."
units.literal: I have already beheaded all ten groups of the earlier envoys who said they could be attacked.'

units.zh: 乃封敬二千戶，為關內侯，號為建信侯。
units.en: He then enfeoffed Liu Jing with two thousand households, granted him the rank of Marquis Within the Passes, and titled him the Marquis of Jianxin.
units.literal: He then enfeoffed Jing with two thousand households, served as Guannei Hou, and titled him Jianxin Hou.

units.zh: 高帝罷平城歸，韓王信亡入胡。
units.en: After Emperor Gao withdrew from Pingcheng and returned, King Xin of Han fled to the Hu.
units.literal: The Gao Emperor dismissed Pingcheng and returned, while Han King Xin fled and entered the Hu.

units.zh: 當是時，冒頓為單于，兵彊，控弦三十萬，數苦北邊。
units.en: At that time, Modu was the Chanyu. His forces were formidable—he commanded three hundred thousand mounted archers and repeatedly ravaged the northern frontier.
units.literal: At this time, Modun served as Chanyu, his troops were strong, he controlled three hundred thousand archers, and frequently pained the northern borders.

units.zh: 上患之，問劉敬。
units.en: The Emperor was troubled by this and consulted Liu Jing.
units.literal: The Sovereign worried about it and asked Liu Jing.

units.zh: 劉敬曰：「天下初定，士卒罷於兵，未可以武服也。
units.en: Liu Jing said: 'The empire has newly been pacified, the officers and soldiers are fatigued by warfare, and it cannot yet be subjugated with martial means.
units.literal: Liu Jing said: 'All-under-heaven newly pacified, officers soldiers fatigued by warfare, not yet can with martial subjugate.

units.zh: 冒頓殺父代立，妻群母，以力為威，未可以仁義說也。
units.en: Modu killed his father and seized the throne, took his father's widows as wives, and rules by force and intimidation—he cannot be won over with benevolence and righteousness.
units.literal: Modu killed his father and replaced him, took his father's widows as wives, uses strength to create awe, and cannot be persuaded with benevolence and righteousness.

units.zh: 獨可以計久遠子孫為臣耳，然恐陛下不能為。」
units.en: Only with a plan for the long term can their descendants serve as ministers, but I fear Your Majesty cannot do it.'
units.literal: Only can with plan long distant descendants serve as ministers, yet fear Your Majesty cannot do.'

units.zh: 上曰：「誠可，何為不能！
units.en: The Sovereign said: 'If it truly can be done, why cannot I do it!
units.literal: Sovereign said: 'Truly can, why cannot!

units.zh: 顧為柰何？」
units.en: But how should it be done?'
units.literal: But do how?'

units.zh: 劉敬對曰：「陛下誠能以適長公主妻之，厚奉遺之，彼知漢適女送厚，蠻夷必慕以為閼氏，生子必為太子。
units.en: Liu Jing replied, "If Your Majesty can truly give him the legitimate eldest princess as his wife and send her with generous gifts, then when he knows that Han has sent a legitimate daughter with such wealth, the barbarians will surely esteem her as Yanzhi, and any son she bears will certainly become crown prince.
units.literal: Liu Jing replied, 'If Your Majesty can truly give him the legitimate eldest princess as wife, with rich gifts sent along, when he knows that Han sends a legitimate daughter with such generosity, the barbarians will surely esteem her as Yanzhi, and any son born will certainly become crown prince.

units.zh: 代單于。
units.en: He will succeed the Chanyu.
units.literal: He will replace the Chanyu.

units.zh: 何者？
units.en: Why is this so?
units.literal: Why?

units.zh: 貪漢重幣。
units.en: Because they covet the lavish gifts of Han.
units.literal: They are greedy for Han's heavy gifts.

units.zh: 陛下以歲時漢所餘彼所鮮數問遺，因使辯士風諭以禮節。
units.en: Your Majesty should regularly send them, according to the seasons, whatever goods are abundant in Han and scarce among them, and dispatch eloquent envoys to instruct them gently in ritual propriety.
units.literal: Your Majesty should frequently bestow upon them what Han has in surplus and they lack according to the seasons, and following this send eloquent scholars to gently exhort them with rites and propriety.

units.zh: 冒頓在，固為子婿；
units.en: While Modun is present, he firmly serves as son-in-law;
units.literal: Modun present, firmly serves as son-in-law;

units.zh: 死，則外孫為單于。
units.en: When he dies, your grandson will become the Chanyu.
units.literal: When he dies, then the grandson will become Chanyu.

units.zh: 豈嘗聞外孫敢與大父抗禮者哉？
units.en: Have you ever heard of a grandson who dares to contend in rites with his grandfather?
units.literal: How ever heard grandson dares with grandfather contend rites?

units.zh: 兵可無戰以漸臣也。
units.en: Without a battle, the Xiongnu could gradually be brought to submission.
units.literal: The troops can without battle gradually make them ministers.

units.zh: 若陛下不能遣長公主，而令宗室及後宮詐稱公主，彼亦知，不肯貴近，無益也。」
units.en: If Your Majesty cannot send the eldest princess, but orders the imperial clan and rear palace to falsely call someone princess, they will also know, and will not be willing to honor and approach her. It will be of no benefit.'
units.literal: If Your Majesty cannot send eldest princess, yet orders imperial clan and rear palace falsely call princess, they also know, not willing honor approach, no benefit.'

units.zh: 高帝曰：「善。」
units.en: The Gao Emperor said: 'Good.'
units.literal: Gao Emperor said: 'Good.'

units.zh: 欲遣長公主。
units.en: He wished to send the eldest princess.
units.literal: He desired to send the eldest princess.

units.zh: 呂后日夜泣，曰：「妾唯太子、一女，柰何棄之匈奴！」
units.en: Empress Lu wept day and night, saying, "I have only the Crown Prince and one daughter. How can I cast her away to the Xiongnu?"
units.literal: Empress Lü wept day and night, saying, 'I have only the crown prince and one daughter—how can I abandon her to the Xiongnu!'

units.zh: 上竟不能遣長公主，而取家人子名為長公主，妻單于。
units.en: In the end, the Emperor could not bring himself to send the eldest princess. Instead, he took a girl from a common family, bestowed on her the title of eldest princess, and married her to the Chanyu.
units.literal: The Sovereign finally could not send the eldest princess, but took a child from a commoner family and named her the eldest princess to be wife to the Chanyu.

units.zh: 使劉敬往結和親約。
units.en: He sent Liu Jing to negotiate and conclude the marriage alliance.
units.literal: He sent Liu Jing to go and tie the peaceful kinship covenant.

units.zh: 劉敬從匈奴來，因言「匈奴河南白羊、樓煩王，去長安近者七百里，輕騎一日一夜可以至秦中。
units.en: When Liu Jing returned from the Xiongnu, he said, "The Xiongnu kings Baiyang and Loufan south of the Yellow River are, at their nearest point, only seven hundred li from Chang'an; light cavalry could reach the Qin heartland in a single day and night.
units.literal: When Liu Jing returned from the Xiongnu, he then said, 'The Xiongnu kings Baiyang and Loufan south of the Yellow River are, at nearest, seven hundred li from Chang'an; light cavalry can reach the heart of Qin in one day and one night.

units.zh: 秦中新破，少民，地肥饒，可益實。
units.en: The heartland of Qin has been recently devastated and is sparsely populated, yet the land is fertile and abundant—it can be further settled and filled.
units.literal: Qin central has newly been broken, has few people, the land is fertile and abundant, and can be increased and filled.

units.zh: 夫諸侯初起時，非齊諸田，楚昭、屈、景莫能興。
units.en: When the feudal lords first rose in rebellion, none could have succeeded without the Tian clans of Qi and the Zhao, Qu, and Jing clans of Chu.
units.literal: Now when the feudal lords initially arose, without the various Tian of Qi and the Zhao, Qu, Jing of Chu, none could rise.

units.zh: 今陛下雖都關中，實少人。
units.en: Now, though Your Majesty has established the capital in Guanzhong, the population there is in truth too sparse.
units.literal: Now although Your Majesty has the capital in Guanzhong, in reality it has few people.

units.zh: 北近胡寇，東有六國之族，宗彊，一日有變，陛下亦未得高枕而臥也。
units.en: To the north, Hu raiders are close by; to the east are the clans of the six states, with powerful lineages. If one day disorder breaks out, Your Majesty still will not be able to sleep soundly.
units.literal: To the north the Hu raiders are near; to the east are the clans of the six states, strong in lineage. If one day there is trouble, Your Majesty cannot yet sleep soundly either.

units.zh: 臣願陛下徙齊諸田，楚昭、屈、景，燕、趙、韓、魏後，及豪桀名家居關中。
units.en: I request that Your Majesty relocate the Tian clans of Qi, the Zhao, Qu, and Jing clans of Chu, the descendants of the Yan, Zhao, Han, and Wei ruling houses, and all the powerful and prominent families to reside in Guanzhong.
units.literal: I wish Your Majesty to move the various Tian of Qi, the Zhao, Qu, Jing of Chu, the descendants of Yan, Zhao, Han, Wei, and the heroic stalwart famous families to dwell in Guanzhong.

units.zh: 無事，可以備胡；
units.en: In peacetime, it can serve to guard against the Hu;
units.literal: In peacetime it can serve to guard against the Hu;

units.zh: 諸侯有變，亦足率以東伐。
units.en: Should the feudal lords rebel, these relocated families would also serve as a ready force to lead eastward in a punitive campaign.
units.literal: If the feudal lords rebel, it is also sufficient to lead them in attacking eastward.

units.zh: 此彊本弱末之術也」。
units.en: This is the method of strengthening the root and weakening the branches.'
units.literal: This strengthen root weaken branches method.'

units.zh: 上曰：「善。」
units.en: The Sovereign said: 'Good.'
units.literal: Sovereign said: 'Good.'

units.zh: 乃使劉敬徙所言關中十餘萬口。
units.en: He then dispatched Liu Jing to relocate over a hundred thousand people to Guanzhong, as he had advised.
units.literal: He then sent Liu Jing to move what he had spoken of—ten-plus ten thousand people—to Guanzhong.

units.zh: 叔孫通者，薛人也。
units.en: Shusun Tong was a native of Xue.
units.literal: Shusun Tong was a man of Xue.

units.zh: 秦時以文學徵，待詔博士。
units.en: During the Qin dynasty, he was summoned for his learning and served as an erudite awaiting imperial orders.
units.literal: During Qin times he was summoned for his literature and awaited decrees as an erudite.

units.zh: 數歲，陳勝起山東，使者以聞，二世召博士諸儒生問曰：「楚戍卒攻蘄入陳，於公如何？」
units.en: Several years later, Chen Sheng rose east of the mountains. When an envoy reported this, the Second Emperor summoned the erudites and scholar-students and asked, "Chu garrison soldiers have attacked Qi and entered Chen. What do you gentlemen make of this?"
units.literal: After several years Chen Sheng arose east of the mountains. An envoy reported it. The Second Emperor summoned the erudites and scholar-students and asked, 'Chu garrison soldiers have attacked Qi and entered Chen—what do you gentlemen make of this?'

units.zh: 博士諸生三十餘人前曰：「人臣無將，將即反，罪死無赦。
units.en: The erudites and students, more than thirty men, came forward and said: 'Subjects may not command troops; if they do, they are rebelling. The crime is death with no pardon.
units.literal: The erudites and students, more than thirty men, advanced and said: 'Subject ministers may not command troops; if they do, then they are rebelling. The crime is death with no pardon.

units.zh: 願陛下急發兵擊之。」
units.en: We wish Your Majesty to urgently send troops and strike them.'
units.literal: Wish Your Majesty urgently send troops strike them.'

units.zh: 二世怒，作色。
units.en: The Second Emperor was enraged, his expression darkening.
units.literal: The Second Generation was angered and changed color.

units.zh: 叔孫通前曰：「諸生言皆非也。
units.en: Shusun Tong stepped forward and said, "The scholars' words are all wrong.
units.literal: Shusun Tong stepped forward and said, 'The scholars' words are all wrong.

units.zh: 夫天下合為一家，毀郡縣城，鑠其兵，示天下不復用。
units.en: All under heaven has been united as one family. The walls of the commanderies and counties have been torn down, their weapons melted, to show the realm they will never be used again.
units.literal: Now all under heaven is united as one family. The commandery and county walls have been destroyed, their weapons melted, showing all under heaven they will not be used again.

units.zh: 且明主在其上，法令具於下，使人人奉職，四方輻輳，安敢有反者！
units.en: Moreover, an enlightened ruler is at the top; below, the laws are complete, making everyone fulfill their duties. The four directions converge like spokes to a hub—how dare there be any who rebel!
units.literal: Moreover, enlightened ruler at top, laws commands complete at bottom, makes everyone fulfill duty, four directions spokes converge, how dare have rebel persons!

units.zh: 此特群盜鼠竊狗盜耳，何足置之齒牙閒。
units.en: These are merely a pack of petty thieves—rats pilfering and dogs stealing—hardly worth mentioning.
units.literal: This is only a group of bandits—rat stealing, dog stealing—what is worth placing between the teeth.

units.zh: 郡守尉今捕論，何足憂。」
units.en: The commandery governor and commandant's assistant will now capture and judge them—what is there to worry about."
units.literal: Commandery governor and commandant's assistant now capture and judge them, what is there worth worrying.'

units.zh: 二世喜曰：「善。」
units.en: The Second Generation was pleased and said: 'Good.'
units.literal: Second Generation pleased said: 'Good.'

units.zh: 盡問諸生，諸生或言反，或言盜。
units.en: He questioned all the scholars, and some called it rebellion while others called it banditry.
units.literal: He asked all the various students, and the various students either said it was rebellion or said it was bandits.

units.zh: 於是二世令御史案諸生言反者下吏，非所宜言。
units.en: The Second Emperor then ordered the Imperial Secretary to investigate those scholars who had called it rebellion and hand them over to the authorities, for speaking what was improper.
units.literal: Thereupon the Second Generation ordered the imperial secretary to investigate the various students who said it was rebellion and send them to the officials, as they had not spoken what was proper.

units.zh: 諸言盜者皆罷之。
units.en: All those who had called it banditry were dismissed from their posts.
units.literal: All those who said it was bandits were dismissed.

units.zh: 乃賜叔孫通帛二十匹，衣一襲，拜為博士。
units.en: He bestowed upon Shusun Tong twenty bolts of silk and a set of clothes, and appointed him as a court erudite.
units.literal: He then granted Shusun Tong twenty bolts of silk, one set of clothes, and appointed him as an erudite.

units.zh: 叔孫通已出宮，反舍，諸生曰：「先生何言之諛也？」
units.en: After Shusun Tong left the palace and returned to his lodging, the students said: 'Sir, why did you speak so flatteringly?'
units.literal: Shusun Tong had left the palace and returned to his lodging when the students said: 'Sir, why were your words so flattering?'

units.zh: 通曰：「公不知也，我幾不脫於虎口！」
units.en: Tong said, "You gentlemen do not understand. I nearly failed to escape the tiger's mouth!"
units.literal: Tong said, 'You gentlemen do not understand—I nearly did not escape the tiger's mouth!'

units.zh: 乃亡去，之薛，薛已降楚矣。
units.en: He then fled to Xue, but Xue had already surrendered to Chu.
units.literal: He then fled and went to Xue, but Xue had already submitted to Chu.

units.zh: 及項梁之薛，叔孫通從之。
units.en: When Xiang Liang came to Xue, Shusun Tong attached himself to him.
units.literal: When Xiang Liang went to Xue, Shusun Tong followed him.

units.zh: 敗於定陶，從懷王。
units.en: After the defeat at Dingtao, he followed King Huai.
units.literal: After the defeat at Dingtao, he followed the Huai King.

units.zh: 懷王為義帝，徙長沙，叔孫通留事項王。
units.en: When King Huai was made the Righteous Emperor and relocated to Changsha, Shusun Tong remained behind to serve King Xiang.
units.literal: The Huai King became the Righteous Emperor and moved to Changsha, while Shusun Tong stayed and served Xiang Wang.

units.zh: 漢二年，漢王從五諸侯入彭城，叔孫通降漢王。
units.en: In the second year of the Han dynasty, the King of Han entered Pengcheng with the forces of five feudal lords, and Shusun Tong surrendered to the King of Han.
units.literal: In the second year of Han, the Han King followed the five feudal lords into Pengcheng, and Shusun Tong submitted to the Han King.

units.zh: 漢王敗而西，因竟從漢。
units.en: When the King of Han was defeated and retreated westward, Shusun Tong followed and ultimately committed himself to the Han cause.
units.literal: The Han King was defeated and fled west, and thus ultimately joined the Han cause.

units.zh: 叔孫通儒服，漢王憎之；
units.en: Shusun Tong wore Confucian robes, and the King of Han disliked them;
units.literal: Shusun Tong wore Confucian robes, which the King of Han disliked;

units.zh: 乃變其服，服短衣，楚製，漢王喜。
units.en: So he changed his attire, adopting a short jacket in the Chu fashion, which pleased the King of Han.
units.literal: So he changed his clothing and wore a short jacket in Chu style, which pleased the Han King.

units.zh: 叔孫通之降漢，從儒生弟子百餘人，然通無所言進，專言諸故群盜壯士進之。
units.en: When Shusun Tong submitted to Han, he was followed by over a hundred Confucian scholar disciples, but Tong made no recommendations for them. Instead, he specifically recommended the former bandit leaders and warriors for advancement.
units.literal: Shusun Tong's submission to Han, followed Confucian scholar disciples over hundred people, but Tong nothing said advanced, specially spoke various former bandit group strong men advanced them.

units.zh: 弟子皆竊罵曰：「事先生數歲，幸得從降漢，今不能進臣等，專言大猾，何也？」
units.en: All the disciples secretly cursed and said, 'We served the master for several years and were fortunate enough to follow him in submitting to Han. Now he cannot advance us, but instead only speaks of promoting those big rogues—what is the reason?'
units.literal: Disciples all secretly cursed said: 'Served master several years, fortunately got follow submit Han, now cannot advance us ministers, specially speak big cunning ones, why?'

units.zh: 叔孫通聞之，乃謂曰：「漢王方蒙矢石爭天下，諸生寧能鬬乎？
units.en: Shusun Tong heard this and then said to them, 'The Han King is currently braving arrows and stones to contend for the empire—how can you Confucian scholars fight?
units.literal: Shusun Tong heard this, then said to them: 'Han King currently braves arrows stones contends for tianxia, various scholars how can fight?

units.zh: 故先言斬將搴旗之士。
units.en: That is why I first recommended warriors who behead enemy generals and seize their banners.
units.literal: Therefore, I first speak of promoting those warriors who behead generals and seize enemy banners.

units.zh: 諸生且待我，我不忘矣。」
units.en: You scholars should wait for me—I will not forget you.'
units.literal: Various scholars temporarily wait for me, I will not forget you.'

units.zh: 漢王拜叔孫通為博士，號稷嗣君。
units.en: The King of Han appointed Shusun Tong as an erudite and bestowed on him the title Lord Successor of Ji.
units.literal: The Han King appointed Shusun Tong as a Doctor and gave him the title 'Successor to Ji.'

units.zh: 漢五年，已并天下，諸侯共尊漢王為皇帝於定陶，叔孫通就其儀號。
units.en: In the fifth year of Han, the empire having been unified, the feudal lords together honored the King of Han as Emperor at Dingtao, and Shusun Tong arranged the ceremonies and titles for the occasion.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Han, having already unified the empire, the feudal lords together honored the Han King as emperor at Dingtao, and Shusun Tong arranged the ceremonies and titles.

units.zh: 高帝悉去秦苛儀法，為簡易。
units.en: Emperor Gao abolished all the harsh ceremonies and regulations of Qin, replacing them with simplicity.
units.literal: The High Emperor completely abolished the harsh Qin ceremonies and laws, making them simple and easy.

units.zh: 群臣飲酒爭功，醉或妄呼，拔劍擊柱，高帝患之。
units.en: The ministers would drink and quarrel over their merits; some, in their drunkenness, would shout wildly, draw their swords, and hack at the pillars. Emperor Gao found this deeply troubling.
units.literal: The assembled ministers drank wine and argued about their merits. Some got drunk and shouted wildly, drew their swords and struck the pillars. The High Emperor was troubled by this.

units.zh: 叔孫通知上益厭之也，說上曰：「夫儒者難與進取，可與守成。
units.en: Shusun Tong knew the High Emperor increasingly disliked this and persuaded him, saying, 'Confucian scholars are difficult to use for conquest, but they can be used for maintaining what has been achieved.
units.literal: Shusun Tong knew High Emperor increasingly disliked it, persuaded High Emperor said: 'Indeed Confucian scholars difficult with for advancement, can with for maintaining achievement.

units.zh: 臣願徵魯諸生，與臣弟子共起朝儀。」
units.en: I wish to summon the Confucian scholars of Lu and, together with my disciples, establish court ceremonies.'
units.literal: Minister wishes summon Lu various scholars, with minister's disciples together establish court ceremony.'

units.zh: 高帝曰：「得無難乎？」
units.en: The High Emperor said, 'Will it not be difficult?'
units.literal: High Emperor said: 'Will it not be difficult?'

units.zh: 叔孫通曰：「五帝異樂，三王不同禮。
units.en: Shusun Tong said, 'The Five Emperors had different music, and the Three Kings had different rites.
units.literal: Shusun Tong said: 'Five Emperors different music, Three Kings different rites.

units.zh: 禮者，因時世人情為之節文者也。
units.en: Rites are the formal patterns shaped by the times and by human nature.
units.literal: Rites are ritual patterns created following the times, generations, and human feelings.

units.zh: 故夏、殷、周之禮所因損益可知者，謂不相復也。
units.en: Thus, the ways in which the rites of the Xia, Yin, and Zhou dynasties adapted, subtracted, and added can be traced—they did not simply repeat one another.
units.literal: Therefore, what was followed, added, or subtracted in the rites of Xia, Yin, and Zhou can be known—they do not simply repeat each other.

units.zh: 臣願頗采古禮與秦儀雜就之。」
units.en: I wish to somewhat collect ancient rites and mix them together with Qin ceremonies to complete them.'
units.literal: Minister wishes somewhat collect ancient rites with Qin ceremonies mix complete them.'

units.zh: 上曰：「可試為之，令易知，度吾所能行為之。」
units.en: The High Emperor said, 'We can try doing it—make it easy to understand and within my ability to perform.'
units.literal: High Emperor said: 'Can try do it, make easy know, measure my ability to do it.'

units.zh: 於是叔孫通使徵魯諸生三十餘人。
units.en: Shusun Tong then sent for more than thirty Confucian scholars from Lu.
units.literal: So Shusun Tong sent to summon over thirty Confucian scholars from Lu.

units.zh: 魯有兩生不肯行，曰：「公所事者且十主，皆面諛以得親貴。
units.en: Lu had two scholars who were unwilling to go and said, 'You, sir, have served nearly ten rulers, and each time you flattered them to gain closeness and nobility.
units.literal: Lu had two scholars unwilling go, said: 'You sir served ones nearly ten rulers, all flattered to face to obtain close nobility.

units.zh: 今天下初定，死者未葬，傷者未起，又欲起禮樂。
units.en: The empire has only just been settled—the dead are not yet buried, the wounded have not yet risen—and already you wish to institute rites and music.
units.literal: Now the empire has just been settled, the dead are not yet buried, the wounded have not yet recovered, and yet you wish to establish rites and music.

units.zh: 禮樂所由起，積德百年而後可興也。
units.en: Rites and music can only flourish after virtue has been accumulated for a hundred years.
units.literal: Rites and music arise only after virtue has been accumulated for a hundred years before they can flourish.

units.zh: 吾不忍為公所為。
units.en: We cannot bring ourselves to do what you advocate.
units.literal: We cannot bear to do what you, sir, are doing.

units.zh: 公所為不合古，吾不行。
units.en: What you propose does not accord with antiquity—we will not participate.
units.literal: What you, sir, are doing does not accord with antiquity—we will not go.

units.zh: 公往矣，無汙我！」
units.en: You, sir, may go—do not defile us!'
units.literal: You sir go, do not defile us!'

units.zh: 叔孫通笑曰：「若真鄙儒也，不知時變。」
units.en: Shusun Tong laughed and said, 'You are truly narrow-minded Confucian scholars who do not understand how times change.'
units.literal: Shusun Tong laughed said: 'You are truly narrow Confucian scholars, do not know times change.'

units.zh: 遂與所徵三十人西，及上左右為學者與其弟子百餘人為綿蕞野外。
units.en: So he went west with the thirty summoned scholars, along with the High Emperor's attendants who were scholars and his own disciples—over a hundred people total—and they practiced in a continuous tent in the open fields.
units.literal: Then with summoned thirty people west, and High Emperor's left right learned ones with his disciples hundred more people made continuous tent open country outside.

units.zh: 習之月餘，叔孫通曰：「上可試觀。」
units.en: After practicing for over a month, Shusun Tong said, 'Your Majesty can try observing.'
units.literal: Practiced it month more, Shusun Tong said: 'High Emperor can try observe.'

units.zh: 上既觀，使行禮，曰：「吾能為此。」
units.en: After the High Emperor observed, he had them perform the rites and said, 'I can do this.'
units.literal: High Emperor already observed, made perform rites, said: 'I can do this.'

units.zh: 乃令群臣習肄，會十月。
units.en: He then ordered all the ministers to practice and rehearse, scheduling the assembly for the tenth month.
units.literal: He then ordered all the ministers to practice and drill, scheduling the assembly for the tenth month.

units.zh: 漢七年，長樂宮成，諸侯群臣皆朝十月。
units.en: In the seventh year of the Han dynasty, when the Changle Palace was completed, all the feudal lords and ministers gathered for the court assembly in the tenth month.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Han, when the Changle Palace was completed, all the feudal lords and ministers assembled for court in the tenth month.

units.zh: 儀：先平明，謁者治禮，引以次入殿門，廷中陳車騎步卒衛宮，設兵張旗志。
units.en: The ceremony: Before dawn, the ye zhe arranged the rites and led them in proper order to enter the hall gate. In the courtyard were arrayed chariots, cavalry, and infantry guarding the palace, with weapons displayed and banners and insignia unfurled.
units.literal: Ceremony: First dawn, ye zhe arranged rites, led in order enter hall gate, courtyard middle arranged chariots cavalry infantry guarded palace, set weapons displayed banners insignia.

units.zh: 傳言「趨」。
units.en: The command was transmitted: 'Hurry!'
units.literal: Transmitted words 'hurry'.

units.zh: 殿下郎中俠陛，陛數百人。
units.en: Below the hall, the Palace Attendants flanked the steps, with several hundred men lining the stairway.
units.literal: Below the hall, the lang zhong flanked the stairs, with several hundred people upon the stairs.

units.zh: 功臣列侯諸將軍軍吏以次陳西方，東鄉；
units.en: The meritorious ministers, ranked marquises, generals, and army officials were arrayed in order on the western side, facing east;
units.literal: Meritorious ministers, ranked marquises, generals, and army officials were arranged in sequence on the western side, facing east;

units.zh: 文官丞相以下陳東方，西鄉。
units.en: The civil officials, from the Chancellor on down, were arrayed on the eastern side, facing west.
units.literal: The civil officials, from the prime minister down, were arrayed on the eastern side, facing west.

units.zh: 大行設九賓，臚傳。
units.en: The Grand Usher arranged the nine ranks of guests, and the heralds relayed the announcements.
units.literal: The grand usher arranged the nine ranks of guests, and the lu proclaimed.

units.zh: 於是皇帝輦出房，百官執職傳警，引諸侯王以下至吏六百石以次奉賀。
units.en: Then the Emperor emerged from his chamber on the imperial carriage. The hundred officials performed their duties and relayed the ceremonial alerts, leading the feudal lords and kings down to officials ranked at six hundred bushels to offer their congratulations in order of precedence.
units.literal: Then the emperor's chariot emerged from the chamber. The hundred officials held their duties and transmitted alarms, leading the feudal lords and kings down to officials of six hundred dan to offer congratulations in order.

units.zh: 自諸侯王以下莫不振恐肅敬。
units.en: From the feudal lords and kings on down, all trembled with awe and solemn reverence.
units.literal: From the feudal lords and kings down, none were not trembling with fear and solemn respect.

units.zh: 至禮畢，復置法酒。
units.en: When the ceremonies were concluded, the ritual wine was served once more.
units.literal: When the rites were finished, ritual wine was again placed.

units.zh: 諸侍坐殿上皆伏抑首，以尊卑次起上壽。
units.en: All those seated in attendance in the hall bowed low and pressed their heads to the ground, then rose in order of rank to offer toasts of longevity.
units.literal: All those attending and seated in the hall above prostrated themselves and lowered their heads, rising in order of nobility to offer long life toasts.

units.zh: 觴九行，謁者言「罷酒」。
units.en: Nine rounds of cups circulated, and the ye zhe announced, 'Dismiss the wine.'
units.literal: Cups nine circulated, ye zhe said 'dismiss wine'.

units.zh: 御史執法舉不如儀者輒引去。
units.en: The censors enforced the rules and immediately escorted out anyone who failed to observe proper ceremony.
units.literal: The imperial secretaries enforced the law and immediately led away anyone who did not conform to the ceremony.

units.zh: 竟朝置酒，無敢讙譁失禮者。
units.en: Throughout the entire court session and banquet, not a single person dared to cause a disturbance or breach propriety.
units.literal: Throughout the morning while wine was placed, none dared make a clamor or lose propriety.

units.zh: 於是高帝曰：「吾乃今日知為皇帝之貴也。」
units.en: Emperor Gao then said, "Only today do I understand the dignity of being emperor."
units.literal: Then Emperor Gao said, 'Only today do I understand how noble it is to be emperor.'

units.zh: 乃拜叔孫通為太常，賜金五百斤。
units.en: He then appointed Shusun Tong as Grand Master of Ceremonies and bestowed upon him five hundred catties of gold.
units.literal: Then he appointed Shusun Tong as Grand Master of Ceremonies and granted him five hundred jin of gold.

units.zh: 叔孫通因進曰：「諸弟子儒生隨臣久矣，與臣共為儀，願陛下官之。」
units.en: Shusun Tong then stepped forward and said, 'These disciples and Confucian scholars have followed me for a long time and helped me create the ceremonies. I wish Your Majesty would give them official positions.'
units.literal: Shusun Tong then advanced said: 'Various disciples Confucian scholars followed minister long already, with minister together made ceremonies, wish Your Majesty official them.'

units.zh: 高帝悉以為郎。
units.en: Emperor Gao appointed every one of them as court attendants.
units.literal: The High Emperor appointed them all as lang (court attendants).

units.zh: 叔孫通出，皆以五百斤金賜諸生。
units.en: When Shusun Tong left the court, he distributed all five hundred catties of gold among the scholars.
units.literal: When Shusun Tong went out, he gave the five hundred jin of gold to the scholars.

units.zh: 諸生乃皆喜曰：「叔孫生誠聖人也，知當世之要務。」
units.en: The scholars were all delighted and said, 'Master Shusun is truly a sage—he understands the essential affairs of our time.'
units.literal: Various scholars then all pleased said: 'Shusun Sheng truly sage person, knows current age's essential affairs.'

units.zh: 漢九年，高帝徙叔孫通為太子太傅。
units.en: In the ninth year of Han, Emperor Gao transferred Shusun Tong to the position of Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince.
units.literal: In the ninth year of Han, the High Emperor transferred Shusun Tong to serve as Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince.

units.zh: 漢十二年，高祖欲以趙王如意易太子，叔孫通諫上曰：「昔者晉獻公以驪姬之故廢太子，立奚齊，晉國亂者數十年，為天下笑。
units.en: In the twelfth year of Han, Gaozu wished to replace the Crown Prince with King Ruyi of Zhao. Shusun Tong admonished the High Emperor, saying, 'Formerly, Duke Xian of Jin deposed the crown prince because of Li Ji and established Xi Qi, plunging Jin into disorder for several decades and making it the laughingstock of the empire.
units.literal: Han twelfth year, Gaozu wished with Zhao King Ruyi change Crown Prince, Shusun Tong admonished High Emperor said: 'Formerly Jin Xian Gong because of Li Ji's sake deposed Crown Prince, established Xi Qi, Jin state in chaos several decades, became tianxia's laughingstock.

units.zh: 秦以不蚤定扶蘇，令趙高得以詐立胡亥，自使滅祀，此陛下所親見。
units.en: Because the Qin failed to designate Fusu early, Zhao Gao was able to fraudulently enthrone Huhai, bringing about the extinction of the Qin sacrificial line—this is something Your Majesty witnessed personally.
units.literal: Qin failed to establish Fusu early, allowing Zhao Gao to fraudulently establish Hu Hai, which caused the Qin sacrifices to be extinguished—this is something Your Majesty witnessed personally.

units.zh: 今太子仁孝，天下皆聞之；
units.en: The current Crown Prince is benevolent and filial—everyone in the empire has heard of this;
units.literal: Now Crown Prince benevolent filial, tianxia all heard of it;

units.zh: 呂后與陛下攻苦食啖，其可背哉！
units.en: Empress Lu shared hardship and coarse food with Your Majesty. How can you turn your back on her?
units.literal: Empress Lü endured hardship and ate meager food with Your Majesty—how can you turn your back on her!

units.zh: 陛下必欲廢適而立少，臣願先伏誅，以頸血汙地。」
units.en: If Your Majesty insists on deposing the rightful heir and establishing a younger son, I wish to be executed first, staining the ground with my neck blood.'
units.literal: Your Majesty must wish depose proper and establish young, minister wishes first receive execution, with neck blood stain ground.'

units.zh: 高帝曰：「公罷矣，吾直戲耳。」
units.en: The High Emperor said, 'Enough, you. I was only joking.'
units.literal: High Emperor said: 'You stop, I only joking.'

units.zh: 叔孫通曰：「太子天下本，本一搖天下振動，柰何以天下為戲！」
units.en: Shusun Tong said, 'The Crown Prince is the root of the empire. If the root shakes even once, the whole empire shakes. How can you treat the empire as a joke!'
units.literal: Shusun Tong said: 'Crown Prince tianxia root, root one shake tianxia shakes, how with tianxia as joke!'

units.zh: 高帝曰：「吾聽公言。」
units.en: The High Emperor said, 'I will listen to your words.'
units.literal: High Emperor said: 'I listen to your words.'

units.zh: 及上置酒，見留侯所招客從太子入見，上乃遂無易太子志矣。
units.en: When the High Emperor held a banquet, he saw the guests recruited by Liu Hou following the Crown Prince in for an audience, and the High Emperor finally abandoned any intention to change the Crown Prince.
units.literal: When High Emperor placed wine, saw Liu Hou's recruited guests follow Crown Prince enter audience, High Emperor then finally had no change Crown Prince intention.

units.zh: 高帝崩，孝惠即位，乃謂叔孫生曰：「先帝園陵寢廟，群臣莫（能）習。」
units.en: After the High Emperor passed away and Emperor Hui ascended the throne, he said to Master Shusun, 'The assembled ministers are not familiar with the rituals for the late emperor's park tomb and ancestral temple.'
units.literal: High Emperor collapsed, Filial Hui ascended throne, then said to Shusun Sheng: 'Late Emperor park tomb sleeping temple, assembled ministers none able practice.'

units.zh: 徙為太常，定宗廟儀法。
units.en: He was transferred to the post of Grand Master of Ceremonies, where he established the ceremonial regulations for the ancestral temples.
units.literal: He was transferred to serve as Grand Master of Ceremonies and established the ceremonial regulations for the ancestral temples.

units.zh: 及稍定漢諸儀法，皆叔孫生為太常所論箸也。
units.en: As Han's ceremonial regulations were gradually established, they were all discussed and codified by Master Shusun during his tenure as Grand Master of Ceremonies.
units.literal: When Han's ceremonial regulations were gradually established, they were all discussed and recorded by Master Shusun while serving as Grand Master of Ceremonies.

units.zh: 孝惠帝為東朝長樂宮，及閒往，數蹕煩人，乃作複道，方筑武庫南。
units.en: Emperor Hui held court at the Changle Palace to the east, and when he traveled there, the repeated clearing of the roads troubled the people. He therefore had a covered walkway constructed, just south of the armory.
units.literal: Emperor Hui went to court at the eastern Changle Palace, and when he went there, repeatedly clearing the way troubled the people. So he built a covered walkway, which was just south of the armory.

units.zh: 叔孫生奏事，因請閒曰：「陛下何自筑複道高寢，衣冠月出游高廟？
units.en: Master Shusun memorialized on affairs, then requested a private audience and said, 'Why does Your Majesty personally build a covered walkway to the high chamber and, wearing court robes, go out monthly to tour the High Temple?
units.literal: Shusun Sheng memorialized affairs, then requested private audience said: 'Your Majesty why personally build covered walkway high chamber, in robes monthly go out tour high temple?

units.zh: 高廟，漢太祖，柰何令後世子孫乘宗廟道上行哉？」
units.en: The High Temple is the temple of Han's Great Ancestor. How can we allow descendants in later generations to travel along the ancestral-temple road?"
units.literal: The High Temple is Han's Great Ancestor—how can we let future generations' descendants travel along the ancestral temple road!'

units.zh: 孝惠帝大懼，曰：「急壞之。」
units.en: Emperor Hui was greatly terrified and said, 'Destroy it immediately.'
units.literal: Filial Hui Emperor greatly feared, said: 'Urgently destroy it.'

units.zh: 叔孫生曰：「人主無過舉。
units.en: Master Shusun said, 'A ruler makes no mistaken actions.
units.literal: Shusun Sheng said: 'Ruler has no mistaken actions.

units.zh: 今已作，百姓皆知之，今壞此，則示有過舉。
units.en: Now that it has already been built and all the people know of it, if we were to tear it down, it would reveal a misstep.
units.literal: Now it has already been built and all the common people know about it. If we destroy it now, it will show that there was a mistaken action.

units.zh: 願陛下原廟渭北，衣冠月出游之，益廣多宗廟，大孝之本也。」
units.en: I wish Your Majesty would establish a temple north of the Wei River and, wearing court robes, go out monthly to tour it. Moreover, expand and increase the ancestral temples—this is the root of great filial piety.'
units.literal: Wish Your Majesty establish temple Wei north, in robes monthly go out tour it, moreover expand many ancestral temples, great filial piety's root.'

units.zh: 上乃詔有司立原廟。
units.en: The Emperor then ordered the responsible officials to establish a branch temple.
units.literal: The Emperor then decreed that the responsible officials establish a branch temple.

units.zh: 原廟起，以複道故。
units.en: The branch temple was established on account of the covered walkway.
units.literal: The Yuan Temple was established because of the covered walkway.

units.zh: 孝惠帝曾春出游離宮，叔孫生曰：「古者有春嘗果，方今櫻桃孰，可獻，願陛下出，因取櫻桃獻宗廟。」
units.en: Once in spring, Emperor Hui went out to tour a detached palace. Master Shusun said, 'In ancient times there was the spring tasting of fruits. Right now the cherries are ripe and can be offered. I wish Your Majesty would go out and thereby take cherries to offer at the ancestral temple.'
units.literal: Filial Hui Emperor once spring went out toured detached palace, Shusun Sheng said: 'Ancient ones had spring tasting fruits, right now cherry ripe, can offer, wish Your Majesty go out, thereby take cherry offer ancestral temple.'

units.zh: 上乃許之。
units.en: The Emperor then granted permission.
units.literal: The Emperor then granted permission.

units.zh: 諸果獻由此興。
units.en: The practice of offering fruits and produce arose from this.
units.literal: The offering of various fruits arose from this.

units.zh: 太史公曰：語曰「千金之裘，非一狐之腋也；
units.en: The Grand Historian said: As the proverb goes, 'A fur coat worth a thousand pieces of gold is not made from the armpit of a single fox;
units.literal: Grand Historian said: Proverb says 'Thousand gold fur coat, not one fox armpit;

units.zh: 臺榭之榱，非一木之枝也；
units.en: The rafters of a pavilion or terrace are not made from the branch of a single tree;
units.literal: Pavilion terrace rafters, not one tree branch;

units.zh: 三代之際，非一士之智也。」
units.en: The governance of the Three Dynasties was not the wisdom of a single scholar.'
units.literal: Three dynasties governance, not one scholar's wisdom.'

units.zh: 信哉！
units.en: How true!
units.literal: Truly!

units.zh: 夫高祖起微細，定海內，謀計用兵，可謂盡之矣。
units.en: Emperor Gaozu rose from the humblest origins to pacify the realm within the seas, exhausting every stratagem and military art.
units.literal: Indeed, Gaozu rose from humble origins, pacified the empire, and exhausted all stratagems and military uses.

units.zh: 然而劉敬脫輓輅一說，建萬世之安，智豈可專邪！
units.en: Yet Liu Jing, after stepping down from his cart, secured peace for ten thousand generations with a single proposal. How could wisdom belong to one class alone?
units.literal: Yet Liu Jing, with one counsel after stepping down from his cart, secured peace for ten thousand generations—how can wisdom be monopolized!

units.zh: 叔孫通希世度務，制禮進退，與時變化，卒為漢家儒宗。
units.en: Shusun Tong gauged the spirit of the age and measured affairs of state, crafting the rites of advancement and withdrawal to suit each change of the times, and in the end became the Confucian patriarch of the Han house.
units.literal: Shusun Tong gauged the spirit of the age and measured affairs of state, formulated the rites of advancement and retreat, changed with the times, and finally became the Confucian patriarch of the Han house.

units.zh: 「大直若詘，道固委蛇」，蓋謂是乎？
units.en: 'The great straight appears bent; the Way is indeed winding'—is this not what it speaks of?
units.literal: 'Great straight like bent, Way indeed winding', probably speaking of this?
